rationale: Official Alfabet help documents an AI Assistant in the product that searches Alfabet online help. A separately license-gated AI Portfolio Management use case is documented too, but it is not needed to establish this product's AI positivity. These are functional statements, not merely branding. Alfabet's strategic portfolio/enterprise architecture offering remains meaningful without the help assistant, so AI-enabled.
ai_type_rationale: AI assistant augments help/search, while the core strategic portfolio management and enterprise architecture work remains independent of it. The specifically licensed AI Portfolio Management use case is a separate optional capability and is not treated as product core.
version_scope: Record does not identify version. Current Alfabet 11.13 online help and 11.9 AI portfolio documentation establish functionality within Alfabet product line but may postdate the record's version; source description itself explicitly claims AI technologies for Alfabet.
issues: Current documentation version may not match an undated source record; AI inclusion and availability can vary by hosting/configuration.

sources.excerpt: An AI Assistant is available on the Alfabet to search for answers in the online help. ... For cloud customers, the help is automatically available. If you are installing Alfabet on premise, installation of the context-sensitive help ... only makes sense if your installation is based on the pre-configured Alfabet solution ...
sources.applicability: Official Alfabet 11.13 help explicitly establishes an AI feature and distinguishes cloud from on-prem availability/configuration.

sources.excerpt: To work with Alfabet's AI portfolio management capabilities, you must have a license to Enterprise Architecture Management. The use case AI Portfolio Management must be enabled.
sources.applicability: Shows other AI-related functionality is separately licensed and use-case enabled; not relied on as the positive basis.

sources.excerpt: Alfabet uses state-of-the-art AI technologies to deliver a powerful strategic portfolio management (SPM) solution.
sources.applicability: Assigned record's AI claim explicitly identifies Alfabet, though source publication/version is not preserved in frozen context.
